pages.text: Mortals must equip any technique before they can automatically absorb nearby Qi particles. Sitting on a cushion greatly improves Cultivation Efficiency, and spirit stones can still refill Qi directly. Breakthroughs grant zhenyuan and also raise all five attributes.$(br2)Broken Vein Stone Body can now absorb Qi and break through, but its max Qi is only one tenth of normal. Be careful around wandering cultivators: higher realms can fly, cast spells, use pills, and counter control effects.
